name: Kikouyoku Senki Gin no Toki no Corona -Fortune Dragon's-
original_name: 輝光翼戦記 銀の刻のコロナ -Fortune Dragon’s-
source: One year has passed after the day when this world was saved from destruction. Tokino and Akane graduated, and with no imminent threat all member now enjoy their long awaited carefree days. But on a certain night of falling stars a new force has begun to move, and once again Touka's exceptional sense warns him about danger.
translation: 从这个世界免于毁灭的那一天起，已经过去了一年。时野和茜毕业了，没有迫在眉睫的威胁，所有成员现在都享受着期待已久的无忧无虑的日子。但在某个流星坠落的夜晚，一股新的力量开始移动，图卡的超凡感知再次向他发出危险警告。
